purpose: Continue upper-body hypertrophy, supported pressing/pulling strength, arm endurance, and conditioning while non-weight-bearing in a left-leg cast; avoid falsely representing in-progress videos as completed.

goals.interpretation: Upper-body training can help preserve muscle and pressing strength. Squat progression and leg loading are paused until orthopedic weight-bearing and rehabilitation clearance; don't promise that cast-safe work maintains maximal squat ability.

schedule.pattern: 2 or 3 nonconsecutive sessions weekly as individually cleared; alternate A and B; never train a loaded movement through injury pain.
schedule.example: Week 1: A–B–A; Week 2: B–A–B; at least 48 hours between upper-body lifting days when working hard.
schedule.relativeEffort: After medical clearance, start lighter than pre-injury weights, finish with 2–3 good reps left, progress gradually without leg drive.

safety.weightBearing: strictly no load, pressure, pushing, or band anchor through the left cast/foot
safety.position: stable nonrolling back-supported chair with injured left cast elevated and independently supported
safety.gear: dumbbells, safely anchored bands/cables, INNSTAR back pad only in its approved chair position; no unstable anchor or neck routing
safety.noGo: standing, stepping, treadmill, leg loading, hard torso twisting, lifting a weight that requires foot bracing, transfer without support
safety.medicalGate: treating clinician must approve upper-body resistance, session duration, and non-weight-bearing transfers
safety.stop: new leg pain/swelling, chest pain, dizziness, shortness of breath or sharp shoulder pain: stop and seek appropriate medical care

progression.measurement: Track sets, reps, weight/resistance and perceived effort. No need to count clicks in the app while training; guided player must do time/chapters once completed.
progression.rule: Only after medical clearance: when all sets at the top rep limit are controlled on two separate sessions and cast remains unloaded, increase the smallest available amount next time; never force reps or chase old loading during injury.
progression.cardio: Seated boxing requires clearance and must eliminate foot pivots or bracing.

implementation: Use as proposed extension plan for production master builder; do not automatically mark missing scenes completed or publish training release.
